decision.explanation: The source documents explicitly confirm three distinct awards received by Miguel Woites. Document 1 (D1S1-D1S4, D1S18-D1S19) states he was conferred the 'Order of St. Gregory the Great'. Document 2 (D2S1-D2S3) states he was awarded the 'Guggenheim Fellowship'. Document 1 (D1S21) cites the Argentine Journalists' Association revealing he received the 'Konex Award for Journalism' in 2017. All three answers are directly supported by the text and represent distinct valid referents for the question.
